source.stem:
Plant cells are often green but animal cells are not usually green.
Which structure in plant cells makes them green?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Roughage carries waste out of the body through sweat and urine.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: One sip of water a day is enough for nutrient absorption and waste removal.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: High-fibre foods do not provide any nutrients.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Smooth, unstrained whole-carrot purée contains no roughage.

intelligence.enrichment: The body needs dietary fibres and water in addition to essential nutrients; roughage does not provide nutrients but is essential, and water helps absorb nutrients and remove waste through sweat and urine. roughage and water in the diet -> support for digestion, nutrient absorption, and waste removal The learner correctly applies this rule: The body needs dietary fibres and water in addition to essential nutrients; roughage does not provide nutrients but is essential, and water helps absorb nutrients and remove waste through sweat and urine. Only components that provide nutrients are needed by the body.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body. The student must decide: Distinguish essential diet components like roughage and water from nutrients while explaining why they are still needed by the body. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
